name: launchrail
description: A self-hosted platform for health-checked application deployments.

scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,worker,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green 'pnpm --filter @launchrail/api dev' 'pnpm --filter @launchrail/worker dev' 'pnpm --filter @launchrail/web dev'
scripts.test:database: pnpm build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is required for database tests')" && node --env-file-if-exists=.env ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.database.config.ts
scripts.test:queue: pnpm build:packages && node --env-file-if-exists=.env -e "if (!process.env.DATABASE_URL) throw new Error('DATABASE_URL is required for queue tests'); if (!process.env.REDIS_URL) throw new Error('REDIS_URL is required for queue tests')" && node --env-file-if-exists=.env ./node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.queue.config.ts
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:packages && pnpm --filter './packages/*' --parallel typecheck && pnpm --filter './apps/*' --parallel typecheck
